reason: Two database cylinders overlap an open cloud outline. This can read as a unified cloud-storage diagram or a cloud enclosure with independently reusable database content.
uncertainty: Should cloud storage remain a unified diagram, or should the cloud and database symbols be authored separately?

components.name: Open cloud outline
components.description: A cloud enclosure has a tall rounded upper lobe and a smaller right lobe, with an open lower edge. Exclude the database cylinders.

components.name: Paired database cylinders
components.description: Two overlapping database cylinders have elliptical tops and curved horizontal division lines, with the smaller one in front at the right. Exclude the cloud.
